Serving the software engineering community in 2026

Publicity Co-Chair for CASCON 2026, and program committees for ASE 2026 and FSE 2026.

Majid Babaei

2026 · 1 min read

Service

2026
1 min read

Reviewing and organizing are a large part of how a research community works. In 2026 I am serving in three roles:

  • CASCON 2026: Publicity Co-Chair on the organizing committee (committee page).
  • ASE 2026: Program Committee, Tools and Datasets track (committee page).
  • FSE 2026: Program Committee, Student Research Competition (committee page).

These build on my 2025 roles as Proceedings Co-Chair for ICSE 2025, Publicity Co-Chair for SEAMS 2025, and Publicity Chair for SERP4IoT 2025. I also served on program committees for ASE (tool demonstrations), MODELS (workshops), and ICPE (data challenge).

Assistant Professor (Tenure-Track), School of Computing, University of the Fraser Valley. I build abstractions that connect people and agentic AI systems, from model-driven engineering to checkable agent teams.
